title: 440 lbs (200 kg) snatch grip deadlifts for 4
summary: That last rep is a good example of what I consider to be bad form on the deadlift: over-utilization of the lower back, under-utilization of the legs. Don't get me wrong, I didn't get injured or suffer any type of pain at all, but this type of technique will eventually lead to a taxed lower back and underfed legs which can result to issues down the line. Don't lift the maximum amount of weights you can: lift the maximum amount of weights you can WITH PROPER FORM.
